name: valid: MCQ card with a qualifier and a real-world usage

english.question: A web application stores user session data and must keep it when an instance is replaced, with the LEAST operational overhead. Which solution meets these requirements?
english.explanation: DynamoDB is serverless and keeps the sessions outside the instances.
english.realWorldUsage: Many web frameworks ship a DynamoDB session store.

options.text: Store the sessions on the instance store volume of each instance.
options.why: Instance store data is lost when the instance stops or is replaced.

options.text: Store the sessions in an Amazon DynamoDB table.
Store the sessions in a self-managed Redis server on Amazon EC2.
options.why: A self-managed server adds patching and failover work, which is the overhead the question asks to avoid.

options.text: Store the sessions in an Amazon EBS volume attached to one instance.
options.why: An EBS volume attaches to one instance at a time, so other instances cannot read the sessions.

zh-CN.question: 一个 Web 应用存储用户会话数据，替换实例时必须保留这些数据，并且运维开销最少。哪种方案满足这些要求？
zh-CN.explanation: DynamoDB 是无服务器的，会话保存在实例之外。
zh-CN.realWorldUsage: 许多 Web 框架都自带 DynamoDB 会话存储。

a.text: 将会话存储在每个实例的实例存储卷上。
a.why: 实例停止或被替换时，实例存储中的数据会丢失。

b.text: 将会话存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 表中。

c.text: 将会话存储在 Amazon EC2 上自行管理的 Redis 服务器中。
c.why: 自行管理的服务器需要打补丁和处理故障转移，这正是题目要避免的运维开销。

d.text: 将会话存储在挂载到某一个实例的 Amazon EBS 卷中。
d.why: EBS 卷一次只能挂载到一个实例，其他实例无法读取会话。

name: valid: Q/A card

english.question: What does Amazon S3 Versioning keep?
english.explanation: Every version of every object, so an overwrite or delete can be undone.

zh-CN.question: Amazon S3 版本控制会保留什么？
zh-CN.explanation: 每个对象的每个版本，因此覆盖或删除都可以撤销。

name: valid: choose-two card with the fullwidth marker

english.question: A company must keep every object in a second Region and prove that no copy can be deleted for seven years. Which combination of actions meets these requirements? (Choose two.)
english.explanation: Replication copies every object; compliance-mode Object Lock cannot be shortened by anyone.

options.text: Enable versioning and S3 Cross-Region Replication.
Enable S3 Transfer Acceleration.
options.why: Transfer Acceleration speeds up uploads; it never copies objects to another Region.

options.text: Enable S3 Object Lock in compliance mode on the destination bucket.
Deny s3:DeleteObject in the destination bucket policy.
options.why: An administrator can edit or remove a bucket policy.

options.text: Enable MFA Delete on the source bucket.
options.why: MFA Delete does not cover the copy in the second Region.

zh-CN.question: 一家公司必须在第二个区域保留每个对象，并证明七年内任何副本都无法删除。哪种操作组合满足这些要求？（选择两项。）
zh-CN.explanation: 复制会拷贝每个对象；合规模式的对象锁定任何人都无法缩短。

a.text: 启用版本控制和 S3 跨区域复制。

b.text: 启用 S3 Transfer Acceleration。
b.why: 传输加速只加快上传，从不把对象复制到另一个区域。

c.text: 在目标存储桶上启用合规模式的 S3 对象锁定。

d.text: 在目标存储桶策略中拒绝 s3:DeleteObject。
d.why: 管理员可以修改或删除存储桶策略。

e.text: 在源存储桶上启用 MFA Delete。
e.why: MFA Delete 不覆盖第二个区域中的副本。
